description:
Ask a question about the company's code and get an answer verified against its live source code and git history: product behavior, features, settings, limits, error messages, recent changes.

DURATION: a fresh investigation takes 20-60 seconds. Repeated questions without `context` are served from cache at once; the cache resets when the code changes.

IF IT TIMES OUT: the investigation keeps running. Ask the IDENTICAL question again about a minute later.

STATUS (also in structuredContent.status): verified = confirmed in the code; backend_only = exists server-side without a visible UI path; not_found = searched, it does NOT exist; unknown = could not conclude, do not relay as fact.

LIMITS: read-only. Some topics may be refused for your profile. On the free plan, 100 questions per month per company, answers served from cache included.

Answers never contain code nor file paths.

context.description: Optional context from your conversation (symptoms, what was tried…). Never cached: omit it for generic questions.

depth.description: quick (default): up to about a minute. thorough: digs deeper; may be capped by the profile.

question.description: The question about the code, as specific as possible. Identical wording hits the cache: after a timeout, repeat it verbatim.

repository.description: Restrict to one repository of your access ("owner/repo" or its short name).

name: ask_code
title: Ask about the code
